messages:
Maya: Quick recap from the Helios postmortem — root cause is a stale CIDR-import rule in the peering controller that allowed a narrow range of cross-tenant routes to be accepted (we're calling it the ‘ghost-route’). Need to lock down ownership, timelines, and recurring detection.

Maya: Action items I captured: 1) fix peering controller validation to reject overlapping imported CIDRs (owner: Oliver, due 2026-04-02). 2) add automated smoke test in onprem staging to simulate route re-imports (owner: Samir, due 2026-04-07). 3) run a tenant isolation audit across last 6 months + alert trigger for overlaps (owner: Priya, due 2026-04-05). 4) postmortem docs + customer outreach draft for Helios (owner: Maya, due 2026-03-30). 5) add a bounded fallback policy to route-programmer to prevent transient acceptance during controller rollouts (owner: Oliver, due 2026-04-09).

Maya: Notes/context: Helios was on Dedicated with a recent on-prem gateway upgrade; their peering config had an edge-exchange appliance that re-advertised a subset of internal prefixes during a control-plane restart. The peering controller accepted the import because validation only checked prefix length and not origin ASN + tag.

Oliver: I can own #1 and #5. For #1 I'll add ASN+tag checks and a stricter overlap matcher. Planning to open PR tomorrow with unit tests and a short integration harness.

Samir: Taking #2. I'll extend the onprem test harness to replay control-plane flaps and assert the controller rejects ghost imports. Will wire it into the nightly pipeline so we catch regressions.

Priya: I'm on #3. Will run a one-off audit job this week, then bake the overlap detector into Optimize's anomaly pipeline. Proposed alert: any imported prefix overlap > /24 with another tenant triggers SEV-warning.

Maya: Good. Two coordination asks: a) Oliver — can you scope how long the rollout to dedicated pools will take once PR lands? we may need a short mitigation for Helios while we patch. b) Samir/Priya — can you collaborate on a deterministic repro so support can triage faster?

Oliver: Rollout estimate: can be staged per-region, ~48h for canary + 72h global if we push to all Dedicated pools. For immediate mitigation, I can add a temporary strict-mode toggle in the controller config for Helios' cluster (requires config push + quick restart).

Samir: Will pair with Priya on repro. I already have a capture from Helios' gateway logs — will sanitize and attach.

Priya: I'll produce the audit results by EOD Friday and share overlap victims list + suggested alert thresholds.

Maya: Customer comms — I'll draft an explanation + timeline (no PII, high level), and include the mitigation steps and ETA for patch. cc @support for the outreach template.

eng-sre-bot: Created ticket INC-23467: "Helios: ghost-route peering fix + audit" and linked PR/CI when available.

Oliver: One more technical detail — route-programmer currently applies imports in the reconciler loop; I'll change it to a two-phase apply: validate -> staged-apply -> final-commit. That prevents transient acceptance during controller restarts.

Samir: For the onprem harness I'll include these steps in the README so customer engineers can reproduce in their lab if needed.

Maya: TL;DR: owners assigned, short-term mitigation available, infra tests + alerts to prevent recurrence. Please ack here when you start work and update INC-23467 with status.

Oliver: ack, starting work tomorrow.

Samir: ack, will post repro artefact to the ticket by Thu.

Priya: ack, audit job kicked off.

Maya: Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m owners sync on Monday to review PRs and rollout plan. :calendar:
